conviction_note: SUPN is three sessions from closing an all-stock merger into Indivior at a fixed 1.5401 INDV shares (close expected 2026-11-02, both votes passed 2026-10-15, INDV already printed Q3 at 07:00 ET today), so SUPN trades as a merger-arb leg of INDV ex-dividend and its own Q3 only moves it through its ~43.5% share of the combined company; a small upside lean (Zurzuvae +19% q/q from Biogen, four straight 6-8% revenue beats) on a compressed scale of ~2.5% gives +0.15 scaled against +0.35 summed findings, the gap being that the summed findings are each small and the scaled number carries the sign doubt.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $221.3M and non-GAAP EPS $0.62 (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SUPN/earnings-forecasts, one source only); FY2026 company guide $860-890M revenue, adjusted operating earnings $150-180M (raised 2026-08-03, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001356576/000135657626000035/ex991earningsrelease.htm); Earnings Whispers FY consensus $868.92M (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/SUPN). H1 actual $426.8M (Q1 $207.7M + Q2 $219.1M), so the guide implies H2 $433-463M; Benzinga's Q3 $221.3M + Q4 $238.1M = $459.4M sits near the top of the guide. Q3 bar has a single source, so findings that depend on it are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest: ~4.8M shares, ~8.3% of float, 9.5 days to cover as of 2026-08-19 settlement (https://equibles.com/stocks/supn/shortinterest); 7.1M shares, 6.96 days as of 2026-06-30 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/supn/, borrow fee 0.4%). No October figure found. Not crowded relative to the merger lock. Options: front chain unusable (total OI 9, ATM legs not two-sided, put/call OI 3.5 on trivial size), so there is no skew and no implied move; a dead chain is consistent with a name about to be converted into INDV shares. Run-up flat: -0.97% over 20 days, -0.71% over 5; 26.7% below 52w high.

findings.finding: SUPN is a merger-arb leg, not a standalone stock, inside this window: stockholders of both companies approved the all-stock merger on 2026-10-15, each SUPN share converts into 1.5401 INDV shares (fixed ratio), Indivior's Q3 release (filed 07:00 ET 2026-10-29, before this window) says close is expected on or about 2026-11-02 with the combined company trading as SUPN from 2026-11-03, and Indivior's $1B special dividend (record date 2026-10-30, ex-date reported as 2026-10-30, ~$8.13-8.47/share, paid after the effective time to pre-closing INDV holders only) means SUPN at $41.77 = 1.5401 x ~$27.1, roughly INDV ($35.39 snapshot) less the dividend: the spread is near zero. So SUPN's own Q3 print moves SUPN and INDV together, through Supernus's ~43.5% share of the combined equity, and standalone guidance is about to stop applying.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print under a signed merger at a near-zero spread. Real prior prints (baseline history rebuilt to item-2.02 results releases; the Oct-19, Jul-22, Apr-22 and Feb-12 rows are date-announcement 8-Ks, not prints): 2026-08-03 +3.07% (merger announced same day), 2026-05-05 +4.59%, 2026-02-24 +5.67%, 2025-11-04 -17.35%. Those were standalone reactions and overstate the scale now.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: this finding is about the SCALE of the reaction, not its sign. If the market were treating SUPN as standalone into its print, SUPN would trade at a visible discount or premium to 1.5401 x INDV ex-dividend and would carry a live option chain; instead the spread is near zero and the chain has 9 contracts of open interest. Anyone sizing SUPN off its standalone reaction history (median ~5% on real prints, one -17%) would overstate the move.
findings.independence: Merger terms and vote: Indivior 10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001625297/000162828026068013/indv-20260930.htm (close on or about 2026-11-02, dividend record date 2026-10-30); exchange ratio and 43.5%/56.5% split: Supernus DEFM14A https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001356576/000110465926107109/tm2625197-1_defm14a.htm; INDV price and $8.13 dividend ex 2026-10-30: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/indv (undated snapshot).

findings.finding: Biogen's Q3 2026 release (2026-10-28, the day before SUPN prints) puts ZURZUVAE at $84.4M, up 53% y/y and up 19% from Q2's $70.8M; Supernus books 50% of Biogen's Zurzuvae net revenue as collaboration revenue ($35.4M in Q2 on $70.8M), so SUPN's Q3 Zurzuvae line is ~$42.2M, about +$6.8M sequentially, roughly 3% of the $221.3M Q3 revenue bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Zurzuvae collaboration revenue has grown every quarter since the Sage acquisition (Q1 $27.6M, Q2 $35.4M); SUPN rose after both 2026 prints (+4.59%, +3.07%) but on beats across several lines, not this one alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Biogen printed one day before SUPN; a single-source Q3 consensus of $221.3M may not have been updated for a +19% q/q Zurzuvae step. If it had been, the Benzinga Q3 figure would sit above $225M. But the number is public, so most of it is likely in, and under the merger lock it moves SUPN only through the combined company.
findings.independence: Q2 Zurzuvae $70.8M from Biogen 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000875045/000087504526000075/biib-20260630.htm); 50% recognition stated in SUPN Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001356576/000135657626000020/ex991earningsrelease.htm). Same underlying number, one finding.

findings.finding: SUPN has beaten revenue consensus by 6-8% in each of the last four quarters (Benzinga table) and raised FY guidance on 2026-08-03 (revenue to $860-890M from $840-870M; adjusted operating earnings to $150-180M), with Qelbree IQVIA TRx +17% y/y in Q2 and Q3 the seasonally strong back-to-school quarter; the Q3 bar of $221.3M is only +1% over Q2's $219.1M, so a further beat is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats with a raise bought +3.07% (2026-08-03, merger day) and +4.59% (2026-05-05) standalone; the 2025-11-04 Q3 print fell 17.35%, so the line has paid both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: A beat is the expected outcome and is priced; what is not priced is any reaction, because the name is pinned to INDV. If the market expected a standalone beat reaction, SUPN would trade at a premium to the exchange ratio, and it does not. Bar is single-sourced, so capped small.
findings.independence: Q2 release with raised guide and Qelbree TRx: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001356576/000135657626000035/ex991earningsrelease.htm. Shares the Q3 bar with finding 2 but rests on a different fact (beat history, guide), so not merged.

findings.finding: S&P DJI announced 2026-10-22 that Huron Consulting replaces SUPN in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective before the open Monday 2026-11-02, so index funds rebalance at the 2026-10-30 close, the exit close of this window; because the acquirer INDV is itself in the SmallCap 600 and the deal is all stock, funds are expected to receive INDV shares rather than sell SUPN, so the flow should be near neutral.
findings.why_not_priced: Announced a week ago and flow-neutral in the usual stock-for-stock treatment; filed so a judge can see the closing-auction date coincides with the window exit. If S&P instead deletes SUPN for cash, there would be selling at the 10-30 close, which the near-zero arb spread would mostly absorb.

baseline_tension: No skew and no usable implied move to cut against; the run-up is flat, and the mild upside lean on SUPN's own numbers is muted by the merger lock that ties SUPN to INDV ex-dividend.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (single-source bar): the Q3 consensus has one source (Benzinga), so the beat-history finding was cut from +0.3 to +0.2 and the Zurzuvae finding from +0.2 to +0.15.

Lesson on history built from the wrong events: confirmed the baseline history mixes date-announcement 8-Ks with prints and rebuilt the base rate from the four real releases; it did not change the scale, which the merger lock had already compressed.

Rule 7: looked up short interest (about 8% of float in August, not crowded) before the one small negative; the index finding was moved from -0.05 to 0.0 as flow-neutral under the stock-for-stock treatment.
